bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative evaluation and literature review applying intersectional feminist principles to analyze structural power, the gender binary, trans exclusion, and reproductive privacy in AI research and deployment.
Theoretical analysis and literature review examining AI datasets, models, and systems through the frameworks of racial capitalism and intersectionality.

Theoretical critique of capitalist power dynamics in AI, evaluating the exploitation of data labor and the systemic bias in predictive AI systems used against economically vulnerable populations (e.g., tenant screening).
Qualitative evaluation of the extractive nature of AI data collection and the outsourcing of traumatizing data-labeling jobs to the Global South, framed as an extension of historical colonialism.
